title: Grateful Dead Live at Fillmore West on 1970-04-11
source: Partial Show Source: sbd > Reel Master > Cassette > DAT (44k)

ai_review.summary: Excellent soundboard capture of a feral, high‑energy Lovelight performance with superb Jerry Garcia playing
ai_review.review: The reviewer raves about the show’s nonstop energy and highlights a delightfully feral minor‑mode take on "Lovelight," calling it possibly their all‑time favorite. The recording is praised implicitly by the 5‑star rating and, given the .sbd. tag, is presumed to be a clean soundboard source with no audible flaws.

ai_rating.rationale: Single enthusiastic 5‑star review indicates an outstanding performance and likely excellent recording; limited data yields low confidence.

recording_quality.technical_notes: No complaints; presumed crisp and clear soundboard capture.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Consistently high energy throughout the concert, with no noted lulls.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Garcia is described as playing in a delightfully feral minor mode.
